requests.name: 圣剑化身
requests.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY: the existing 圣剑化身 card. PRESERVE THE ORIGINAL COMPOSITION EXACTLY; change only painting language and detail density. Images2/3 are broad opaque anime STYLE references only. Image4 is Heixiang's CHARACTER identity reference only, don't copy coffee cup, standing pose or white backdrop.
COMPOSITION LOCK: same 4:3 landscape, same CLOSE LOW-ANGLE upper-body view, muscular dark-skinned male Heixiang centered slightly toward lower-right, identical head size/location, confident grin, eyes clear. His RIGHT arm (viewer LEFT) rises vertically above the head and the same black gloved hand grips the SAME huge GOLD/IVORY holy sword overhead. Preserve blade axis, handle and guard placement, broad crossguard silhouette and top-edge crop. Preserve other shoulder/arm and exact costume silhouette. Same orange scarf around his neck, with its large fluttering branches in the same upper-left and upper-right locations, same broad direction. Same gray armor plate silhouettes over black fitted long-sleeved battle clothes. KEEP the sword's majestic broad shape but reduce internal ornate detailing to a few coarse ochre/ivory paint shapes. DO NOT lower/rotate sword, use two hands, shift body, add characters or redesign staging.
BACKGROUND: preserve existing empty dark-gray/olive overall field, but paint as ONE or TWO quiet SOLID muted warm-gray/charcoal areas, optional large flat muted ochre block behind the raised blade. No realistic lighting fog or scenic background. Remove tiny golden sparks; holy energy is just broad ivory/gold blade color and a few sparse coarse paint swipes. No invented environment, sky, castle or ground.
REPAINTING LANGUAGE: a VERY ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR STUDY. Conspicuously loose broad strokes, incomplete edges and a few selective sketch lines, far less detail than finished fantasy art. A large opaque brush constructs a whole hair mass, armor plane, sleeve plane or magical shape in ONE or a few strokes. Keep a dominant base color, ONE connected shadow group and 2–4 broad midtone dabs per region; large quiet interiors. Irregular handmade boundaries, blunt brush ends and slight overlapping paint. Simplify armor into big clear gray planes with minimal dull ochre accents, NO ornamental etching, embossed symbols, tiny rivets or polished highlights. Muscular body and hand anatomy remain convincingly readable, but do not render every muscle/knuckle. Hair ONE substantial dark swept-back mass with a few broad shadow/highlight marks, no strands. Face distinctly adult masculine anime, warm DARK/BROWN skin, broad jaw, amber eyes, thick brows, sly confident grin, stitched scar on HIS LEFT cheek (viewer RIGHT), clear expressive eye marks and simple nose/mouth, quiet cheek shadow. His BLACK hair is slicked back from his forehead, fully exposing it. Face identity comes from the original target and image4 portrait; don't copy style-reference people. Scarf is a few broad matte ORANGE strokes with large fold divisions; no little fabric lines. Magic motifs are bold opaque color shapes, not photographic light. No airbrush gradients, bloom, lens flares, particles, glossy 3D, realistic shiny metal, dense texture, grain/canvas overlay, small angular chips, fine scratches, tiny decorative marks or vector-perfect tracing. Roughness means FEWER WIDER purposeful marks, NOT noise. Readable face, hands and weapon silhouettes, coarse economical everything else. No text, UI, logo, frame or watermark.
